detail.longDescription: OpenAI is rolling out new models all the time, and you can see the improvements and power even in a quick back-and-forth with ChatGPT. But as much as we all love shooting the breeze with an AI chatbot, the real question is how you can put the AI models to use in your work. With Zapier, ChatGPT builds a workflow, and Zapier keeps it running.
